note: Findings of the V2 CLOSE. Each was found by reading a captured live page or by re-deriving a reported number, not by a test going red. HARNESS findings are defects in the measurement, and are listed because a measurement that is wrong in the flattering direction is the more expensive kind.

findings.title: a quotation ending on a joining word reached the evidence surface
findings.found_by: reading netskope-evidence.html; EVIDENCE_NO_BROKEN_SPANS was the single failing gate in the cohort
findings.root_cause: trim_to_word has refused this since bbb75261. Three other producers shorten a reader-facing quotation and each had its own arithmetic. The passage was also 148 chars against a 320-char budget, so this product did not cut it - the publisher's meta description ended on 'and' - and a producer policing only its own cuts would print it again.
findings.fix: adaptive/spans.end_on_an_idea and elide; all four producers call the one rule

findings.title: the decision question rendered broken English on three of four grounded companies
evidence: Procore: 'without losing more customer count among vital role in our customers' operations than the price gains?'
ServiceTitan: 'among experience their own rapid technological changes than the price gains?'
findings.root_cause: the branch's comment said the head was found 'by cutting the trailing prepositional phrase' and the code tested words[-1]. 'operations' is plural; 'role', the real head, is not. ServiceTitan needed a second rule: a possessive determiner means the phrase points back at a subject named elsewhere.
findings.fix: decision_object._head_noun cuts at the first post-head preposition; _POSSESSIVE refuses a phrase that refers back
findings.cost: differentiation DOWN: Procore and ServiceTitan fall back to the class constant and their grounding falls from GROUNDED to NAME_ONLY. Two of five distinct questions were garbage.

findings.title: a singular billing unit landed after the word 'more'
findings.found_by: reading ninjaone-xray.html: 'without losing more device than the price gains?'
findings.root_cause: the tails are phrased to avoid SUBJECT-VERB agreement; number agreement after 'more' was never covered, and a billing unit is usually a singular count noun
findings.fix: _countable gives a singular unit the shape the class constant already uses ('device count'), idempotent, no guessed plurals

findings.title: DECISION_GRADE_READING never reads the grounding verdict
findings.detail: the label is assigned from discovery.independent_origins > 0 alone. Verkada carried it while its own page said NAME_ONLY and CLASS_PRIOR_ONLY; the companies whose readings were actually GROUNDED were labelled abstentions. The label answers a different question from the one its name asks.
findings.why_not_fixed: changing the classifier inside the freeze would re-label historical rows, which the close forbids. The product's own page is truthful; only the harness label overstates.

findings.title: the learning refusal counts documents that carried text, beside a history page counting documents that carried dates
findings.detail: Okta's learning page says 'only 0 dated document(s) were read' while its history page shows 90. A rehearsal needs a date AND a body on the same object; EDGAR's submissions index supplies dates without bodies. The page states that criterion in the next sentence, so the statement is defensible - but the two surfaces publish two denominators.
findings.why_not_fixed: the bound is real and documented in code; the wording is adjacent to History Rewind, which the next execution owns

findings.title: first progress render exceeds the 3s target on the first request after a deploy
findings.detail: Procore's verification run immediately after the d1c9beae deploy took 8.03s to first progress render and was classified PRODUCT_DEFECT. The same company inside a warmed batch does not reproduce it. Free-tier cold start, not a product path.
findings.hand_off: warm the service before any measured batch

findings.title: a pattern analogue renders as a bare company name
findings.detail: five companies are offered 'How is this transition similar to Notion, and where does the comparison break down?' where others read as a transition ('Slack SMB to enterprise', 'Salesforce to AppExchange', 'Web search to assistants'). It is a hedged suggestion, not an assertion, so it is recorded rather than repaired inside a freeze.

findings.title: a buyer beginning 'IT' is refused as a fragment
findings.detail: _acceptable lowercases the phrase before testing words[0] against _BAD_HEADS, so 'IT teams at mid-market firms' is read as the pronoun 'it'. Pre-existing, not a regression of this close.

findings.title: the previous close's differentiation headlines described 17 companies, not 25
findings.detail: scripts/asi25_analysis.py copied a freshly computed artifact onto its cohort name only 'if not target.exists()'. A 17-company asi25_differentiation.json written mid-run at 03:17 survived every later pass. 'distinct questions 4 -> 8' and 'largest identical group 22-of-33 -> 7-of-14' are figures from that partial.
findings.fix: the collector always overwrites, and reports any artifact still behind the state file

findings.title: the forty's overlap instrument is near-blind on the history surface
findings.detail: it strips every numeral before forming the word set. Okta vs Procore read 0.9908 identical with numerals stripped and 0.6407 with them kept: the years, index values and base year ARE a history page. X-Ray pairs at >=0.98 fall from 14 to 5 under the stricter instrument.
findings.fix: both instruments are reported; the forty's for comparability, the stricter one to tell a real collapse from a blind spot

findings.title: 36 false cross-company contaminations, all the word 'material'
findings.detail: matching a company's first token case-insensitively collided 'Material Security' with this product's own sentence 'everything rests on the company's own material'. 36 of 36 identical is the scorer confessing.
findings.fix: a multi-word name must appear in full; a single-word name must appear capitalised. Negative control proves the audit still fails on a real foreign subject.

findings.title: the abstention audit demanded an element that is inapplicable to a grounded reading
findings.detail: 'WHY IT DID NOT OVERRIDE' was required of all 25 and failed Okta, NinjaOne and ServiceTitan, whose pages say the opposite - the reading turns on what the company itself says it charges for. Required only of a NAME_ONLY reading, the cohort is 25/25.

findings.title: the old-40 controls resolve their captures to the wrong cohort inside this worktree
findings.detail: scripts/next40_controls.py reads <repo>/reports/next40_ui. Inside ie-asi-v2 that directory holds a stale partial of the TWENTY-FIVE under a borrowed name, so running it here would have scored the new cohort and reported the forty as clean. The regression was run against the frozen captures in intent-engine-econ instead.

findings.title: a quoted source was scored as the product's own voice
findings.detail: the 'false vocabulary differentiation' control failed Adastra on the word 'Pharmaceutical', which appears inside Adastra's own success-stories page in its own list of industries served, correctly attributed. The old defect was the product READING a Toronto data consultancy as pharma. Blockquotes are now stripped before the product's voice is scored.

findings.title: a client-side rendering shell was quoted as company evidence
findings.found_by: the section 17 width/theme matrix, on the FIRST run in which that matrix was actually measured
evidence: Coveo /evidence, whole citation under the heading 'Discusses the company directly': 'Loading. x Sorry to interrupt. CSS Error. Refresh.'
Chainguard /full: '...The world's leading companies trust Chainguard. null.'
findings.root_cause: is_filing_furniture knows a filing's cover page; nothing knew a browser shell scraped before client-side rendering replaced it. Two shapes: a whole passage that is furniture, and one sentence of a real passage that is.
findings.fix: adaptive/spans.drop_rendering_artefacts, applied per SENTENCE by both citation producers; anchored, so 'the null hypothesis' and 'uploading' are untouched
findings.blast_radius_proved_offline: 3 of 396 captured quotations across all 25 companies; Coveo 1, Chainguard 2

findings.title: a bounded run explains itself less completely than the other bounded run
findings.detail: Clio and Axonius are both RETRIEVAL_LIMITATION_HANDLED_CORRECTLY. Axonius addresses 7/9 economic questions and its page names what would settle the decision; Clio addresses 2/9 and does not. The ten-dimension matrix therefore grades Clio FAIL on ECONOMIC_INTELLIGENCE and STRATEGIC_DECISION where Axonius is PASS_BOUNDED. The bound is legitimate; the explanation of it is not as good.
findings.why_not_fixed: the fix is copy on the bounded-run page, which is adjacent to the surfaces the next execution owns, and it is the only company affected

findings.title: the UI dimension had NEVER been measured, across two closes
findings.detail: next40_ten_dimensions.py reads reports/next40_ui_widths.json and looks up widths.get(slug).overflow. No producer ever wrote a slug-keyed map, and the alias symlink was never created because a stale real file from the previous close sat in its place. So measured was False for all 25, UI was NOT_MEASURED for the whole cohort, and the close reported the width/theme matrix as complete. Once the map was written the dimension measured 23 PASS / 2 FAIL / 0 unmeasured -- and the 2 FAILs are P1-7, found only because of this.
findings.fix: the widths artifact now carries a slug-keyed entry per company holding the WORSE of the two themes, and next40_ui_widths.json is the symlink the ALIASES table always intended

findings.title: the stale-spinner detector matched 'loading' inside 'uploading'
findings.detail: _SPINNER had no word boundaries, so Island's result page was reported as carrying a stale spinner because of the phrase 'entering or uploading sensitive data'. This is the same defect the product itself was repaired for at bbb75261, where _FIRST_PERSON matched inside 'however' -- a substring wall reported against real prose. A detector that invents a finding costs more than one that misses it, because the invented one gets reported.
findings.fix: word boundaries, with a positive control (fires on 'Loading. Please wait.') and a negative control (silent on 'uploading')

findings.title: the collector destroyed two fresh artifacts with stale ones
findings.detail: the first repair of H-5 made the collector overwrite unconditionally but chose the target by replacing 'next40_' with 'asi25_'. next40_differentiation writes the TEMPLATE measurement and STEPS sends it to asi25_template.json, so the substitution destroyed the real 25-company asi25_differentiation.json; it also copied next40_ui_widths.json and next40_findings.json, which nothing in STEPS produces -- they are INPUTS. Caught by the freshness check added in the same repair.
findings.fix: collect by the STEPS mapping itself, refuse a source older than the state file, and name the inputs the freshness check must not judge

findings.title: the UI measurement read overflow and contrast from keys that do not exist
findings.detail: measure.js returns overflow and contrast; the first browser extraction asked for over and fails, got undefined, and (m.over||0) turned that into 0. '0 overflow, 0 contrast failures' would have been reported from fields never read.
findings.fix: re-extracted with the real keys, and a positive control page (a 900px body in a 375px frame with two #ccc-on-#fff paragraphs) proves the detector fires: overflow 1, contrast 2 at ratio 1.61, and the ordinary paragraph not flagged
